units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 19b:15">B. Mets. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>מצא ש׳</he> if one finds a receipt (of a woman concerning her jointure).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20a:3">Ib. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ בזמנו טריף</he> a deed of renunciation takes effect from its date (irrespective of the date of delivery).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:9">Keth. IX, 9</cite> <he>אבר שׁוֹבְרִי</he> I lost my receipt; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁוֹבְרִים</he>, <he>שׁוֹבְרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:3">M. Kat. III, 3</cite>; Y. ib. 82ᵃ bot., v. <cite ref="A00693"><he>אוֹמוֹלוֹגְיָיא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:7">B. Mets. I, 7</cite>; a. fr.
